scope: unavailable-backend behavior, finite vectors, exact index/data provenance, stale refresh isolation, raw identifier disclosure, ranking-metric semantics, multilingual contract declaration, concurrent refresh/search isolation, access control, cache headers, and in-memory retention boundaries
confirmed_findings_fixed: Refresh and search now share a re-entrant lock; refresh clears the live index and provenance before validation, so failed or empty replacement builds cannot leave prior workforce text queryable.
Embeddings, query vectors, backend result shapes, distances and scores are checked for finite, aligned, non-negative and shape-compatible evidence; malformed backend responses fail closed.
A supported API search is bound to the exact workspace, dataset, generation and current frame fingerprint. Missing, stale or changed provenance returns unavailable/conflict and no result payload.

The search API no longer serializes EmployeeID. The current web renderer and dormant Streamlit renderer also avoid displaying raw worker identifiers while retaining internal metadata for legacy index compatibility.
The API distinguishes missing PerformanceText from an unavailable optional backend/index and returns no-store-sensitive responses through the existing access boundary.
Search results expose dataset provenance and explicitly retain inverse squared L2 ranking semantics; no probability, relevance validation or employment recommendation claim is made.
interpretation_boundary: Vector search retrieves candidate workforce-text passages. Similarity scores are inverse squared L2 ranking indices, not probabilities, truth values, validated relevance ratings, employee assessments or employment recommendations.

offline_metric_contracts.note: Metric arithmetic and ranking semantics are tested with controlled synthetic relevance labels; this is not model or population validity.

multilingual_validation.limit: This is a small synthetic acceptance corpus, not an organization-approved holdout or population-level relevance validation.

retention_and_access_boundary: The vector index is process-memory only; clear_index, empty rebuild, reset and failed refresh remove indexed text and its provenance from the live engine.
The API remains protected by the existing sensitive.read permission and no-store cache policy; this cycle adds no remote access or persistence path.
Raw worker identifiers remain internal metadata for legacy indexing compatibility and are not a supported API or rendered result field.
remaining_scientific_limits: The real benchmark passed on the small synthetic corpus, but must be rerun against a fixed organization-approved holdout before any public relevance claim.
No validated no-match threshold exists; unrelated queries may still return candidate passages.
No independent holdout, population-level relevance study, concurrency/load benchmark, tenant-isolation deployment test or retention review has been completed.
The governed runtime intentionally leaves vector indexing as an explicit downstream operation; the supported API remains unavailable until a provenance-bound index is prepared.
release_gate: NO-GO for public semantic-search claims. Local code contracts are clean, but the optional backend, real relevance/multilingual evidence, benchmark/holdout, load/concurrency evidence and explicit owner/independent review remain pending.
